sections.title:
Close claims in days,
not months.
sections.sub: Cura automates EU261 and UK261 compensation end-to-end: intake, verification, fraud checks, payout and the authority response.

sections.title: Claims volumes keep rising. Headcount doesn't.
body: Disruption claims arrive by web form, email, social media and claims agencies. Each one needs the booking, the flight record, the weather and the right regulation before anyone can decide.
Cura gathers all of that automatically, so your team spends its time on the cases that need judgement.

items.question: Which regulations does Cura cover?
items.answer: EU261, UK261 and the Montreal Convention, with more added as rules change.

items.question: Do we have to replace our CRM?
items.answer: No. Cura connects to the systems you already run and writes the result back to them.

items.question: How long does it take to go live?
items.answer: Most airlines start with one channel in a few weeks, then add the rest.
